name: shopify-chatgpt-ads
description: Manage ChatGPT (OpenAI) ads for a Shopify store from your agent: campaigns, ads, reports, product feed, tracking. Everything starts paused; spending and permanent changes wait for your yes (asked by your client or through a confirmed dry run). Measured orders and True ROAS through Avada's free app. Plus read-only skills for ChatGPT traffic, tracking and store readiness.

openai_ads_api_key.title: OpenAI Advertiser API key
openai_ads_api_key.description: From ads.openai.com > Settings > API keys. Stored in your system keychain and passed only to the local MCP server.

avada_api_key.title: Avada API key (optional)
avada_api_key.description: avk_live_... from Avada ChatGPT Ads > Settings > AI agents > API keys, for measured orders and True ROAS. Leave empty if you connect Avada's hosted server instead.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Offer no write tool at all: reports and checks only.
